assumptions: 8 honest creators with organic traffic over one month; 3 fraudsters, one per attack type.
bot burst = 4,000 views in 2 hours from aged accounts, one view each.
sock puppets = 300 accounts under 24 h old, 8 views each.
self views = the creator watching their own item 1,200 times.
Each fraudster also posts organic-looking traffic, so 'no organic views' is not the giveaway.
Earnings are views-only here, to isolate the view rules; in the app a visit is worth 25 views, which is the real defence.
Fraud is unsubtle. A patient attacker with aged accounts viewing once each at human pace would evade all four rules.
The rules are the app's own functions (app.watch.views, app.partner.invalid).
